pass_conditions: Set nondefault locks, repair scope and preferences; resize through mobile and desktop layouts and verify the selections remain identical.

evidence_needed: Recorded control values and request payloads before/after resize and recovery.

conditions.exact_condition: Set nondefault locks, repair scope and preferences; resize through mobile and desktop layouts and verify the selections remain identical.
proof_observables: Nondefault lock on assigned slot-A and independent repair on assigned slot-B simultaneously selected under repair mode.
Committed preference slot-B/person-B/Avoid100 and unsent dropdown slot-C/person-A/Prefer-100 kept distinct.
One open current workspace traverses1280→320→768→1280 with snapshots identical for all planning controls and checkbox identities; browser emulation only.

conditions.exact_condition: Inject a recoverable frontend failure and recover without resetting those choices or changing the eventual request payload.
proof_observables: First capabilities GET503 raises frontend-handled recoverable action error before any jobs POST.
Explicit Generate retry retains every planning value and sends exact same jobs body as no-failure paired control.

Separate injected one-shot frontend callback error in AbortSignal.timeout(15000) before the capability request produces same preserved state and explicit-retry payload; caught by action wrapper, not global pageerror.
Actual jobs POST/validate responses are locally fulfilled completed proposals; no Apply, no assignment persistence, no GPU requested.

evidence_rules: Record source hashes before and after, exact served TS source maps and CSS responses, browser/role/fixture, raw requests, per-viewport control snapshots, error state and successful retry.
Use one paired baseline per engine then compare both error runs to that baseline; committed preferences inferred also from exact request rather than count alone.
Scope excludes conflict handoff/new workspace, explicit discard/reopen, page reload/crash, physical-device/native assistive-technology behavior.
No source change recommended unless observed test mismatch establishes actual defect.
execution_contexts: 9 contexts:3 engines × baseline,capabilities503,one-shot frontend timeout-construction exception. Each configured context traverses four viewport widths and records controls.
